simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְשׂוּרָה (H4884) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מְשׂוּרָה (mᵉsûwrâh) means a measure (for liquids) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 23 29.

definitions.full: H4884. mesurah מְשׂוּרָה noun feminine measure, of water , Ezek 4:11 , 16 (|| מִשְׁקָל ); capacity in General, Lev 19:35 ( + מִשְׁקָל מִדָּה, ), 1Chr 23:29 (derivatives dubious) מָשׂוֺשׂ see שׂוֺשׂ . מִשְׂחָק see שׂחק . מַשְׂטֵמָה see שׂטם . [ מְשֻׂכָֿה ] see שׂוך . p. 962, 966, 968 מַשְׂכִּיל see שׂכל . מַשְׂכִּית see שׂכה . [ מַשְׂכֹּ֫רֶת ] see שׂכר . [ מַשְׂמֵר ] see שׂמר . מִשְׂמָּח see שׂפח . מִשְׂרָה see שׂרה . [ מִשְׂרָפוֺת ], מַיִם מִשְׁרְפוֺת see שׂרף . מַשְׂרֵקָה see שׂרק .
